sloka: कामम् तु इदम् पुष्पित वृक्ष सण्डम्नाना विधैः पक्षि गणैः उपेतम् ।वनम् प्रयाता नु तत् अपि अयुक्तम्एकाकिनी सा अति बिभेति भीरुः ॥३-६३-१५॥
transliteration: kāmam tu idam puṣpita vṛkṣa saṇḍamnānā vidhaiḥ pakṣi gaṇaiḥ upetam ।vanam prayātā nu tat api ayuktamekākinī sā ati bibheti bhīruḥ ॥3-63-15॥

translations.english: Could she have gone to the forest where there are many kinds of trees in full bloom inhabited by a variety of birds? That is also not possible as she is timid and too scared to go there alone.
